senses.gloss: m. (dial. for דשתקא, v. preced.; Dithpe. denom. of שַׁקָּא; cmp. Syr. אסתקא, דסתקא, P. Sm. 325; 931) handle of an axe, sword &c.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 3:22">Targ. Jud. III, 22</cite>.—
Y. Erub. V, 22ᵈ bot. דשקתא דגזוראי (read: דִּשְׁתְּקָא) the handle of a wood-cutters’ axe (wedged in between two buildings of a court). [Correct s. v. גְּזוֹרָאָה: (גזר) wood-cutter.]
